verdict.rationale: Codegen provides multiple first-party channels for observing agent activity: a CLI/TUI for 'browsing agents, viewing runs' with 'full telemetry and monitoring' (codegen-docs-12, codegen-docs-21, codegen-docs-30), a web UI that surfaces traces, an Agent Run Logs API exposing 'the agent's thought process, tool usage, and execution flow' (codegen-docs-27), and endpoints to list/resume agent runs implying live status tracking (codegen-docs-35, codegen-docs-36). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that monitoring is truly real-time (vs. periodic log retrieval) and explicit documentation of a live status enum (running/paused/failed) surfaced in the UI.
